blocks.text: A single program may encounter different types of exceptions. Python allows catching multiple exceptions in one try–except block. Each exception type can be handled with a specific response. This approach prevents unexpected crashes and ensures proper error recovery. Handling multiple exceptions improves program stability and control over errors.
